testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel a staged model-state suppression change: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:1232:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel a staged model-state suppression change ✔ Given The MCAD Software has a part with an extrusion suppressed in Primary and Capture State ✔ And the extrusion is computed in Copy State ✔ When the user opens the model-state table ✔ Then the extrusion column shows Suppress for Primary and Capture State ✔ And the extrusion column shows Compute for Copy State ✔ When the user edits the Primary extrusion cell ✔ Then the cell offers Compute and Suppress ✔ When the user selects Compute ✔ Then the Primary cell displays Compute ✔ And OK is enabled ✔ When the user cancels and reopens the model-state table ✔ Then the Primary extrusion cell displays Suppress ✔ And the other two extrusion values are unchanged
